source_match_scope: Exact served index, guide, every static asset, OpenAPI version and functional feature requests. Does not hash private container backend files.

feature.probe: exact-call scoped prior approval and IDNA host match

limitations: This audits supplied trace statements only; no tool is executed and approvals/enforcement are not independently verified.
Approvals authorize only the exact call ID and must precede its one call. Later approvals do not retroactively authorize calls.
Domains are exact normalized hosts: no implicit subdomains, redirects, DNS resolution or wildcard matching. Ports are not restricted by this policy.
Tool names are case-sensitive. http/browser calls require a target URL; any other tool with a URL is also checked against the host allowlist.
Custom tool network behavior cannot be inferred: supply its URL to audit the host; only http/browser require a URL automatically.
A passing trace is not a security certification or evidence that omitted actions did not occur.

backend_freshness.attribution: Root collected private container bytes and native Docker-health evidence. Independent reviewer compared the full app mapping against current files, matched container/image identity and checked fresh actual HTTP/public bytes; private bytes were not collected by this reviewer.
